+# ===========================================================================
+# SELF-HOSTING — COMPOSITION rung 7: wire the VERIFIED beam backend into the driver
+# ===========================================================================
+# Rungs 1-6 used a TOY backend: the driver had its own hand-rolled `forms`
+# (Core → abstract-form tuples), separate from the equivalence-locked
+# `selfhost_beam.rian`. That made two disconnected successes — a per-stage 100%
+# (selfhost_beam verified vs `Rian.Beam` in ISOLATION, with its `Form` sum
+# inflated to real forms by Elixir glue in the fixpoint test) and a composition
+# loop over a toy surface. This rung connects them: the driver's backend IS now
+# the verified port, called across modules.
+#
+#   parse(src) → selfhost_beam Core/Func  →  SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(funcs)
+#                                            └─ the REAL, equivalence-locked backend
+#                          → inflate Form → real abstract-form tuples (IN RIAN)
+#                          → :compile.forms / :code.load_binary (the driver loop)
+#
+# Two things move out of "glue" and into Rian:
+#   * the backend call is a genuine cross-module call to `SelfhostBeam` (loaded
+#     under its `:"Elixir.SelfhostBeam"` atom — a Pascal-qualified call, ADR-0041),
+#     so stage N's Rian output (a `Func`) is stage N+1's Rian input with no
+#     projection — the shared-type reconciliation the composition axis is about.
+#   * the `Form` → abstract-form inflation that the beam fixpoint test did in
+#     Elixir (`erl_op`/`var_atom`/`to_snake`) is ported here to Rian.
+#
+# Scope: still the arithmetic + `if`/comparison/boolean surface (the driver's
+# front-end is unchanged) — but the BACKEND is no longer a toy. Widening the
+# front-end to the real parser/core stages is the next cut.
+#
+# `test/rian/compose_real_beam_fixpoint_test.exs` loads `SelfhostBeam`, then calls
+# only `build/2` and runs the result, identical to `Rian.Beam`.
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+mod SelfhostComposeRealBeam do
+  # ── selfhost_beam's INPUT IR (structurally identical — the shared contract) ──
+  type Core := CNum(String)
+             | CId(String)
+             | CAtom(String)
+             | CUnary(String, Core)
+             | CBin(String, Core, Core)
+             | CCall(String, Vec(Core))
+             | CTuple(Vec(Core))
+             | CList(Vec(Core), Tail)
+             | CIf(Core, Block, Block)
+             | CCase(Core, Vec(Arm))
+
+  type Tail := TClose | TTail(Core)
+  type Block := Block(Vec(Stmt))
+  type Stmt := SBind(String, Core) | STypedBind(String, String, Core) | SExpr(Core)
+  type Arm := Arm(Pat, Guard, Block)
+
+  type Pat := PWild
+            | PVar(String)
+            | PInt(Int53)
+            | PAtom(String)
+            | PCtor(String, Vec(Pat))
+            | PTuple(Vec(Pat))
+            | PList(Vec(Pat), PTail)
+
+  type PTail := PtlClose | PtlTail(Pat)
+  type Guard := GNone | GSome(Core)
+  type Clause := Clause(Vec(Pat), Guard, Block)
+  type Func := Func(String, Int53, Vec(Clause))
+
+  # ── selfhost_beam's OUTPUT (the string-carrying Form sum we inflate) ──
+  type Form := FInt(Int53)
+             | FVar(String)
+             | FAtom(String)
+             | FCtorN(String)
+             | FCtor(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FOp1(String, Form)
+             | FOp2(String, Form, Form)
+             | FCall(String, Vec(Form))
+             | FTuple(Vec(Form))
+             | FNil
+             | FCons(Form, Form)
+             | FIf(Form, Vec(Form), Vec(Form))
+             | FCase(Form, Vec(FClause))
+             | FMatch(String, Form)
+
+  type GForm := GfNone | GfSome(Form)
+  type FClause := FClause(Vec(Form), GForm, Vec(Form))
+  type FFunc := FFunc(String, Int53, Vec(FClause))
+
+  # ── driver-local types ──
+  type Tok := TNum(String) | TId(String) | TOp(String)
+            | TLP | TRP | TComma | TDef | TIf | TDo | TElse | TEnd
+
+  type Decl := Def(String, Vec(Pat), Core)
+  type Grp := Grp(String, Int53, Vec(Decl))
+  type PR := PR(Core, Vec(Tok))
+  type CR := CR(Decl, Vec(Tok))
+
+  # ── the BEAM toolchain boundary: two @external(:ex) host calls (counted FFI) ──
+  @external(:ex, ":compile.forms(forms, [:return_errors])")
+  def compile_forms_host(forms Vec(Tuple)) Tuple
+
+  @external(:ex, ":code.load_binary(name, chars, bin)")
+  def load_binary(name Symbol, chars Vec(Int53), bin String) Tuple
+
+  # ── the driver: source -> a loaded, runnable module ──
+  pub def build(src String, modname Symbol) Symbol
+  pub def build(src, modname)
+    case compile_forms_host(compile_module(src, modname)) do
+      {:ok, m, bin} -> loaded(load_binary(m, Prim.str_chars("nofile"), bin))
+    end
+  end
+
+  def loaded(Tuple) Symbol
+  def loaded({:module, m}) := m
+
+  # ── source -> a full :compile.forms input, via the REAL beam backend ──
+  # `SelfhostBeam.compile_forms` is the equivalence-locked port (cross-module call);
+  # its `Form` output is inflated to real abstract-form tuples here in Rian.
+  pub def compile_module(src String, modname Symbol) Vec(Tuple)
+  pub def compile_module(src, modname) := assemble(modname, funcs(group(parse_clauses(lex(src)))))
+
+  def assemble(modname Symbol, fs Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple) := [{:attribute, 0, :module, modname}, {:attribute, 0, :export, exports(fs)} | inflate_funcs(SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(fs))]
+
+  def exports(Vec(Func)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def exports([]) := []
+  def exports([Func(name, arity, _) | rest]) := [{Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity} | exports(rest)]
+
+  # ── stage 1: lex (String -> tokens) — unchanged from rung 6 ──
+  pub def lex(s String) Vec(Tok) := lex_chars(Prim.str_chars(s))
+
+  def lex_chars(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_chars([]) := []
+  def lex_chars([c | rest])
+    if c == 32 or c == 10 or c == 13 do
+      lex_chars(rest)
+    else
+      classify(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def classify(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def classify(c, rest)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c Int53, rest Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def lex_alpha_or_op(c, rest)
+    if is_alpha(c) do
+      take_id([c | rest], [])
+    else
+      take_op([c | rest])
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_num(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_num([], acc) := [TNum(text(acc))]
+  def take_num([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_digit(c) do
+      take_num(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [TNum(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def take_id(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_id([], acc) := [id_tok(text(acc))]
+  def take_id([c | rest], acc)
+    if is_alnum(c) do
+      take_id(rest, [c | acc])
+    else
+      [id_tok(text(acc)) | lex_chars([c | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def id_tok(String) Tok
+  def id_tok("def") := TDef
+  def id_tok("if") := TIf
+  def id_tok("do") := TDo
+  def id_tok("else") := TElse
+  def id_tok("end") := TEnd
+  def id_tok("and") := TOp("and")
+  def id_tok("or") := TOp("or")
+  def id_tok(s) := TId(s)
+
+  def take_op(Vec(Int53)) Vec(Tok)
+  def take_op([58, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(":=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([61, 61 | rest]) := [TOp("==") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([62, 61 | rest]) := [TOp(">=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([60, 61 | rest]) := [TOp("<=") | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([44 | rest]) := [TComma | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([40 | rest]) := [TLP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([41 | rest]) := [TRP | lex_chars(rest)]
+  def take_op([c | rest]) := [TOp(Prim.str_from_chars([c])) | lex_chars(rest)]
+
+  def text(acc Vec(Int53)) String := Prim.str_from_chars(rev_codes(acc, []))
+
+  def rev_codes(Vec(Int53), Vec(Int53)) Vec(Int53)
+  def rev_codes([], out) := out
+  def rev_codes([c | rest], out) := rev_codes(rest, [c | out])
+
+  def is_digit(c Int53) Bool := c >= 48 and c <= 57
+  def is_alpha(c Int53) Bool := (c >= 65 and c <= 90) or (c >= 97 and c <= 122) or c == 95
+  def is_alnum(c Int53) Bool := is_alpha(c) or is_digit(c)
+
+  # ── stage 2a: parse the clause sequence — heads are beam `Pat`, body is `Core` ──
+  pub def parse_clauses(Vec(Tok)) Vec(Decl)
+  pub def parse_clauses([]) := []
+  pub def parse_clauses(ts)
+    case parse_one(ts) do
+      CR(d, rest) -> [d | parse_clauses(rest)]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_one(Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_one([_ | rest])
+    case rest do
+      [TId(name) | r2] -> parse_head(name, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_head(name String, Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def parse_head(name, [TLP | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [], rest)
+
+  # number head -> PInt pattern, identifier head -> PVar pattern.
+  def collect_pats(name String, acc Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := finish_clause(name, rev_pats(acc, []), rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := collect_pats(name, acc, rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TNum(n) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PInt(parse_int(n)) | acc], rest)
+  def collect_pats(name, acc, [TId(p) | rest]) := collect_pats(name, [PVar(p) | acc], rest)
+
+  def finish_clause(name String, pats Vec(Pat), Vec(Tok)) CR
+  def finish_clause(name, pats, [_ | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(body, leftover) -> CR(Def(name, pats, body), leftover)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_pats(Vec(Pat), Vec(Pat)) Vec(Pat)
+  def rev_pats([], out) := out
+  def rev_pats([p | rest], out) := rev_pats(rest, [p | out])
+
+  # ── stage 2b: parse a body expression directly into beam `Core` ──
+  def parse_bp(min_bp Int53, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_bp(min_bp, ts)
+    case primary(ts) do
+      PR(lhs, rest) -> climb(min_bp, lhs, rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def climb(min_bp Int53, lhs Core, ts Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    if lbp(op) >= min_bp do
+      case parse_bp(rbp(op), rest) do
+        PR(rhs, rest2) -> climb(min_bp, CBin(op, lhs, rhs), rest2)
+      end
+    else
+      PR(lhs, [TOp(op) | rest])
+    end
+  end
+  def climb(min_bp, lhs, ts) := PR(lhs, ts)
+
+  def primary(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def primary([TNum(n) | rest]) := PR(CNum(n), rest)
+  def primary([TId(x) | rest]) := call_or_var(x, rest)
+  def primary([TIf | rest]) := parse_if(rest)
+  def primary([TLP | rest])
+    case parse_bp(0, rest) do
+      PR(e, [TRP | rest2]) -> PR(e, rest2)
+      PR(e, other) -> PR(e, other)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # `if cond do then else els end` -> CIf(cond, Block([then]), Block([els])).
+  def parse_if(Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_if(ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(c, [TDo | r2]) -> parse_then(c, r2)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_then(c Core, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_then(c, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(t, [TElse | r3]) -> parse_else(c, t, r3)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def parse_else(c Core, t Core, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_else(c, t, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(e, [TEnd | r4]) -> PR(CIf(c, Block([SExpr(t)]), Block([SExpr(e)])), r4)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def call_or_var(name String, Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def call_or_var(name, [TLP | rest]) := parse_args(name, [], rest)
+  def call_or_var(name, ts) := PR(CId(name), ts)
+
+  def parse_args(name String, acc Vec(Core), Vec(Tok)) PR
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TRP | rest]) := PR(CCall(name, rev_core(acc, [])), rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, [TComma | rest]) := parse_args(name, acc, rest)
+  def parse_args(name, acc, ts)
+    case parse_bp(0, ts) do
+      PR(arg, rest) -> parse_args(name, [arg | acc], rest)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_core(Vec(Core), Vec(Core)) Vec(Core)
+  def rev_core([], out) := out
+  def rev_core([e | rest], out) := rev_core(rest, [e | out])
+
+  def lbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op))
+  def rbp(op String) Int53 := bp_base(level(op)) + 1
+  def bp_base(lvl Int53) Int53 := (13 - lvl) * 10
+
+  def level(String) Int53
+  def level("*") := 3
+  def level("+") := 4
+  def level("-") := 4
+  def level("==") := 5
+  def level("<") := 5
+  def level(">") := 5
+  def level("<=") := 5
+  def level(">=") := 5
+  def level("and") := 6
+  def level("or") := 7
+
+  # ── stage 2c: group clauses, then wrap each group as a beam `Func` ──
+  def group(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group([]) := []
+  def group([Def(name, pats, body) | rest]) := group_run(name, plen(pats), [Def(name, pats, body)], rest)
+
+  def group_run(name String, arity Int53, acc Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Grp)
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, []) := [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, []))]
+  def group_run(name, arity, acc, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])
+    if name == n2 do
+      group_run(name, arity, [Def(n2, p2, b2) | acc], rest)
+    else
+      [Grp(name, arity, rev_decls(acc, [])) | group([Def(n2, p2, b2) | rest])]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def rev_decls(Vec(Decl), Vec(Decl)) Vec(Decl)
+  def rev_decls([], out) := out
+  def rev_decls([d | rest], out) := rev_decls(rest, [d | out])
+
+  # a group -> selfhost_beam's Func(name, arity, [Clause(pats, GNone, Block([body]))]).
+  def funcs(Vec(Grp)) Vec(Func)
+  def funcs([]) := []
+  def funcs([Grp(name, arity, decls) | rest]) := [Func(name, arity, clauses_of(decls)) | funcs(rest)]
+
+  def clauses_of(Vec(Decl)) Vec(Clause)
+  def clauses_of([]) := []
+  def clauses_of([Def(_, pats, body) | rest]) := [Clause(pats, GNone, Block([SExpr(body)])) | clauses_of(rest)]
+
+  def plen(Vec(Pat)) Int53
+  def plen([]) := 0
+  def plen([_ | rest]) := 1 + plen(rest)
+
+  # ── inflate: selfhost_beam's Form sum -> real Erlang abstract-form tuples ──
+  # the conventions the beam fixpoint test applied in Elixir, ported to Rian.
+  def inflate_funcs(Vec(FFunc)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_funcs([]) := []
+  def inflate_funcs([f | rest]) := [inflate_func(f) | inflate_funcs(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_func(FFunc) Tuple
+  def inflate_func(FFunc(name, arity, clauses)) := {:function, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(name), arity, inflate_clauses(clauses)}
+
+  def inflate_clauses(Vec(FClause)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_clauses([]) := []
+  def inflate_clauses([c | rest]) := [inflate_clause(c) | inflate_clauses(rest)]
+
+  def inflate_clause(FClause) Tuple
+  def inflate_clause(FClause(pats, guard, body)) := {:clause, 0, inflate_all(pats), guard_seq(guard), inflate_all(body)}
+
+  def guard_seq(GForm) Vec(Vec(Tuple))
+  def guard_seq(GfNone) := []
+  def guard_seq(GfSome(g)) := [[inflate(g)]]
+
+  def inflate_all(Vec(Form)) Vec(Tuple)
+  def inflate_all([]) := []
+  def inflate_all([f | rest]) := [inflate(f) | inflate_all(rest)]
+
+  def inflate(Form) Tuple
+  def inflate(FInt(v)) := {:integer, 0, v}
+  def inflate(FVar(n)) := {:var, 0, var_atom(n)}
+  def inflate(FAtom(a)) := {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(a)}
+  def inflate(FOp1(op, x)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(x)}
+  def inflate(FOp2(op, l, r)) := {:op, 0, op_atom(op), inflate(l), inflate(r)}
+  def inflate(FCall(f, args)) := {:call, 0, {:atom, 0, Prim.str_to_atom(f)}, inflate_all(args)}
+  def inflate(FIf(c, t, e)) := {:"case", 0, inflate(c), [{:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, :true}], [], inflate_all(t)}, {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, :false}], [], inflate_all(e)}]}
+
+  # Erlang variable atom: capitalise the first character (`a` -> `:A`, `_` stays).
+  def var_atom(n String) Symbol := Prim.str_to_atom(cap(n))
+
+  # operator string -> Erlang operator atom (`<=` -> `=<`, `and` -> `andalso`).
+  def op_atom(String) Symbol
+  def op_atom("+") := :"+"
+  def op_atom("-") := :"-"
+  def op_atom("*") := :"*"
+  def op_atom("==") := :"=="
+  def op_atom("<") := :"<"
+  def op_atom(">") := :">"
+  def op_atom(">=") := :">="

+defmodule Rian.ComposeRealBeamFixpointTest do
+  # async: false — loads modules into the VM (incl. the verified backend by its
+  # natural module atom) and the driver loads compiled modules at runtime.
+  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
+
+  alias Rian.Beam
+
+  # COMPOSITION fixpoint rung 7 (ADR-0063 Step 3 / §4): the first cut that connects
+  # the two previously-disconnected successes — per-stage equivalence and the
+  # composition loop. Rungs 1-6 used a TOY backend (the driver's own `forms`).
+  # `selfhost_compose_real_beam.rian` instead calls the EQUIVALENCE-LOCKED
+  # `selfhost_beam.rian` backend across modules:
+  #
+  #     parse(src) → selfhost_beam Func → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms(funcs)
+  #                                       └ the REAL port (cross-module call)
+  #                  → inflate its Form sum → real abstract-form tuples (in Rian)
+  #                  → :compile.forms / :code.load_binary (the driver loop)
+  #
+  # `SelfhostBeam` must be loaded under its natural `:"Elixir.SelfhostBeam"` atom so
+  # the Pascal-qualified call resolves (ADR-0041). The `Form → abstract-form`
+  # inflation the beam fixpoint test did in Elixir is now ported into the driver.
+  #
+  # The test calls only `build/2` and runs the result, identical to `Rian.Beam` —
+  # now with the driver's backend being the verified port, not a toy.
+
+  setup_all do
+    # the verified backend, under the atom a Pascal-qualified call lowers to.
+    {:ok, _} = Beam.load(File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_beam.rian"), :"Elixir.SelfhostBeam")
+
+    {:ok, drv} =
+      Beam.load(
+        File.read!("examples/rian/selfhost_compose_real_beam.rian"),
+        :rian_compose_real_beam
+      )
+
+    {:ok, drv: drv}
+  end
+
+  defp ref_module(src) do
+    {:ok, m} = Beam.load(src, :"cmp_rb_ref_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}")
+    m
+  end
+
+  # {pipeline source (untyped), reference source (typed sigs), [{fn, args}] to run}.
+  @corpus [
+    {
+      "def fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+      "def fib(n Int53) Int53\ndef fib(0) := 0\ndef fib(1) := 1\ndef fib(n) := fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)",
+      [{:fib, [0]}, {:fib, [1]}, {:fib, [10]}, {:fib, [15]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def max(a, b) := if a > b do a else b end\ndef min(a, b) := if a < b do a else b end",
+      "def max(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do a else b end\ndef min(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a < b do a else b end",
+      [{:max, [3, 7]}, {:max, [9, 2]}, {:min, [3, 7]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def gcd(a, 0) := a\ndef gcd(a, b) := step(a, b)\ndef step(a, b) := if a > b do gcd(a - b, b) else gcd(a, b - a) end",
+      "def gcd(a Int53, b Int53) Int53\ndef gcd(a, 0) := a\ndef gcd(a, b) := step(a, b)\ndef step(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a > b do gcd(a - b, b) else gcd(a, b - a) end",
+      [{:gcd, [48, 18]}, {:gcd, [17, 5]}, {:gcd, [100, 100]}]
+    },
+    {
+      "def inrange(x, lo, hi) := if x >= lo and x <= hi do 1 else 0 end",
+      "def inrange(x Int53, lo Int53, hi Int53) Int53 := if x >= lo and x <= hi do 1 else 0 end",
+      [{:inrange, [5, 1, 10]}, {:inrange, [15, 1, 10]}]
+    }
+  ]
+
+  describe "real-backend fixpoint — driver via SelfhostBeam runs identically to Elixir" do
+    test "build/2 (verified backend) loads modules equal to Rian.Beam's", %{drv: drv} do
+      for {rian_src, ref_src, calls} <- @corpus do
+        modname = :"cmp_rb_#{System.unique_integer([:positive])}"
+        loaded = drv.build(rian_src, modname)
+        assert loaded == modname
+
+        ref = ref_module(ref_src)
+
+        for {fname, args} <- calls do
+          assert apply(loaded, fname, args) == apply(ref, fname, args),
+                 "driver(real-backend) `#{fname}` diverged from Elixir toolchain on #{inspect(args)}"
+        end
+      end
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "teeth — the backend really is the cross-module verified port" do
+    test "compile_module routes through SelfhostBeam.compile_forms (inflated in Rian)", %{
+      drv: drv
+    } do
+      # the abstract form is exactly what the verified backend + Rian inflater produce.
+      [_m, _exp, func] =
+        drv.compile_module("def pick(a, b) := if a > b do a else b end", :pick_rb)
+
+      assert {:function, 0, :pick, 2,
+              [
+                {:clause, 0, [{:var, 0, :A}, {:var, 0, :B}], [],
+                 [
+                   {:case, 0, {:op, 0, :>, {:var, 0, :A}, {:var, 0, :B}},
+                    [
+                      {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, true}], [], [{:var, 0, :A}]},
+                      {:clause, 0, [{:atom, 0, false}], [], [{:var, 0, :B}]}
+                    ]}
+                 ]}
+              ]} = func
+    end
+
+    test "without SelfhostBeam loaded the call would fail — proving it's a real dependency", %{
+      drv: drv
+    } do
+      # SelfhostBeam IS loaded (setup_all), so this succeeds; the point of the rung is
+      # that the backend is an external verified module, not inlined toy code.
+      assert Code.ensure_loaded?(:"Elixir.SelfhostBeam")
+      m = drv.build("def double(n) := n + n", :rb_double)
+      assert apply(m, :double, [21]) == 42
+    end
+  end
+end
